description.value: An exploratory study examined behavioral and gray-matter correlates of intentional emotional facial expression in neurodegenerative disease patients and healthy controls.
Participants with neurodegenerative disease and healthy controls completed intentional emotional expression and socioemotional assessments and underwent structural MRI.

instructions.value: Participants were verbally prompted to produce emotional facial expressions and to imitate facial expressions shown in pictures.

spans.text: In the verbal command condition, participants were verbally prompted to produce six distinct emotional facial expressions (happiness, disgust, fear, anger, sadness, and surprise (e.g., “Now, show me on your face what it looks like to be happy”)). In the picture imitation condition, participants were asked to imitate pictures of six different emotional faces (e.g., “Now make the face/facial expression shown in this picture”).
